title: Malaysian Grilled Chicken Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make recipe for Malaysian-style grilled chicken skewers, perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor gathering.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together kecap manis, ginger, garlic, chili peppers, and lime juice.
2. Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
3. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. If using coconut milk, brush it onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
8. Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs and steamed rice or noodles if desired.
